name: pr-company-income-tax
description: Puerto Rico regular company income tax reference based on the official legislative-library code revised in May 2026. Separates the normal tax base from the surtax base, sets out the graduated surtax and controlled-group deduction allocation, and explains why alternative minimum tax requires its own calculation. Includes worked examples and the statutory return and payment framework. Identifies special-decree deadlines and financial-statement requirements without treating every company as an ordinary corporation. Later amendments, current administrative filing instructions, incentives, losses, credits and independent accountant review remain outstanding. This source-cited draft does not establish comprehensive Puerto Rico coverage.
